subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “For Earth Day, a school displayed a large sign: 'We do not inherit Earth from the past.”?
options: They chose one project: reducing single-use lunch items.
The school made a new rule: students could not use phones during lunch.
After lunch, the internet became weak, and several students could not use their maps online.
Sam opened his lunch box and found only rice.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「They chose one project: reducing single-use lunch items.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The school made a new rule: students could not use phones during lunch.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After lunch, the internet became weak, and several students could not use their maps online.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sam opened his lunch box and found only rice.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They chose one project: reducing single-use lunch items.」，答案為「They chose one project: reducing single-use lunch items.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They chose one project: reducing single-use lunch items.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
